strategy: build-in-place (BP framework as gap map; no legacy/ restructure)

security.note: PEP, capability tokens, ledger, budget, breaker, confidence, perimeter, signed policy bundles (CTRL-L6-03: two-person change, verified at the boundary), control_status. The keystone; verified/tested.

platform.note: AgentPlatform live loop is the single side-effect path; blast_radius + secure-by-inheritance provisioning.

memory.note: Four-tier store + quarantine + scope isolation tested in-process; gap = Postgres row-level security to move isolation below the app.

orchestration.note: Offline event-sourced exactly-once engine; BP4 wired its journal into the executor sandbox so exactly-once replay is now on the live loop by default (CTRL-L4-05). Remaining gap = prod would back the journal with Temporal.io rather than the in-repo engine.

connectors.note: Multi-model routing, policy-aware fail-closed fallback, MoA.

critique.note: HMDC gated critique wired onto the live boundary (BP7) via security/critique_gate.py:HMDCGate as a pre-execution gate (CTRL-L5-06); deterministic guardrails + environmental verifier hard-gate, judge uncertainty routes to a human. Remaining gap = no formal release-gate registry and the judges are offline lexical stand-ins (connector-backed judge = seam).

domains.note: Domain verifier packs feeding the HMDC task_gate; the NetworkMitigationVerifier now gates the live loop before every side effect (BP7, CTRL-L5-08).

server.note: Control API drives the real PEP; BP3.1-3.3 closed the front door (CTRL-L4-03 verified: auth+RBAC over the whole /api surface, CTRL-L4-07 rate limiting, CTRL-L4-08 structural multi-tenant isolation). Remaining seams: OIDC/SSO, external RBAC store, Postgres RLS, SDK/CLI.

agent.note: reasoning/planner/memory/parameter_tuning. Legacy planner toggle and history.json superseded by the enforced path; kept for TC1/TC2.

maestro.note: 7-layer taxonomy, Table-4 threats (Eq.1 consistency), risk_score, mitigation catalogue, mapping/layers.

telemetry.note: PerformanceMonitor saturation model (drives TC1); gap = signed/rate-limited telemetry + collector isolation for the SOC ref.

experiments.note: TC1 DoS (modeled, A13) + TC2 memory poisoning reproductions.

cli.py.note: maestro-validate entry; gap = full lifecycle CLI/SDK.
